frozen_snapshot.title: Blind diachronic and translation pilot over Heidegger Gesamtausgabe
frozen_snapshot.hypothesis: Independent reviewers can distinguish local textual claims, editorial claims, reconstructions, bridges and ontological promotions across GA phases without relying only on signature vocabulary.
frozen_snapshot.counter_hypothesis: The protocol merely redescribes familiar Heideggerian periodization and loses discriminability when volume numbers, dates and signature terms are masked.

unit_of_analysis.description: One complete argumentative transition in the licensed German GA text, with page and section boundaries preserved.
unit_of_analysis.context_rule: Include the full paragraph and at most one adjacent paragraph on either side; never join passages across a section boundary.
unit_of_analysis.stable_id_rule: SHA-256 of edition identifier, GA volume, page range, normalized source bytes and unitization rule version.

codebook.question: Is the claim explicitly asserted in the cited German passage?
codebook.positive_criterion: A bounded source span contains the proposition or its unambiguous grammatical equivalent.
codebook.boundary: Do not import an editor's blurb, later self-interpretation or Russian translation choice.

codebook.question: Is the claim supplied by an editor, publisher or catalog rather than Heidegger's object text?
codebook.positive_criterion: The claim occurs in metadata, afterword, apparatus or publisher description.
codebook.boundary: Editorial chronology may orient research but cannot substitute for primary textual evidence.

codebook.question: Is the claim an explicit reconstruction from more than one passage?
codebook.positive_criterion: The inference cites its input passages and states a defeasible reconstruction rule.
codebook.boundary: Do not relabel reconstruction as quotation or direct textual meaning.

codebook.question: Does the claim cross a phase, vocabulary, work, language or level through an explicit bridge?
codebook.positive_criterion: Source and target relata, relation type, evidence and defeating rival are all recorded.
codebook.boundary: Lexical resemblance and Heidegger's later self-narration are not sufficient bridges.

codebook.question: Does the claim promote textual or phenomenological evidence into an ontological conclusion?
codebook.positive_criterion: The claim says what or how something is, not merely how the passage describes or accesses it.
codebook.boundary: Access, wording, historical sequence and ontology remain separate channels.

sampling.population: Licensed, edition-resolved German passages from GA 1–105 relevant to the question of being, language, temporality, truth, Ereignis and technology.
sampling.deduplication: Keep the lexicographically first stable unit ID when normalized German spans and edition locators are identical.

visible: German passage with signature terms replaced by typed masks
blinding.risk_tested: Whether classifications depend on Heideggerian keywords rather than transition structure.
Reproducibility of source/reconstruction/bridge distinctions in historical context.
Whether translation choice predetermines the claimed ontology.

metrics.measure: Nominal Krippendorff alpha with bootstrap 95% CI for TXT/EDT/REC/BRG/ONT
metrics.fail_action: Do not describe the claim-mode distinction as independently reproducible.

metrics.measure: Pairwise multilabel F1 for bridge components and defeating rivals
metrics.fail_action: Suspend all cross-phase and cross-language conclusions.

negative_tests.operation: Mask signature terms such as Dasein, Sein, Seyn, Ereignis and Gestell.
negative_tests.fail_action: Downgrade the method to keyword-assisted indexing.

negative_tests.operation: Present matched transitions with GA numbers and dates permuted during the masked phase.
negative_tests.stability_criterion: Reviewers reject false developmental bridges above the preregistered rate.

negative_tests.operation: Repeat reconstruction without publisher descriptions, forewords and editorial afterwords.
negative_tests.stability_criterion: Every retained claim remains supported by object-text passages.
negative_tests.fail_action: Relabel affected claims EDT or remove them.

negative_tests.operation: Swap anonymized Russian translations while holding the German source fixed.
negative_tests.stability_criterion: Ontological status does not track translator choice alone.
negative_tests.fail_action: Suspend the Russian concept passport and return to the German source.

kill_criteria.condition: The German corpus lacks edition-resolved page locators or lawful reproducible access.
kill_criteria.action: Stop corpus-level execution; retain only the bibliographic map.

kill_criteria.condition: Claim-mode alpha or its lower CI fails the frozen threshold.
kill_criteria.action: Revise or merge the failed distinctions before a new preregistration.

kill_criteria.condition: Chronology-swap or editorial-removal tests leave the same developmental conclusions intact.
kill_criteria.action: Treat the periodization as circular and delete the strong developmental model.

kill_criteria.condition: ONT labels cannot be distinguished from TXT/REC after term masking.
kill_criteria.action: Forbid ontological promotion and retain the system as a source-audit tool only.

data.note: A catalog snapshot and one diagnostic page do not constitute an immutable GA corpus.

authorization.note: Authorization must be established for corpus-scale acquisition and processing.

license.note: Publisher metadata is accessible; a reusable full-text research corpus is not licensed by this fact.

coders.note: No independent German-reading coders have been assigned.

frozen_snapshot.deviation_policy: Preserve the frozen plan, record every corpus, codebook, unitization or threshold change by JSON path, and issue a new preregistration before confirmatory coding.
